capabilities: spawn a wild Pokemon after a configurable number of typed characters
record each catch with timestamp and a direct link to the source note
browse a 1025-entry Pokedex grid with generation, type and note filters
download 2050 sprite GIFs from PokeAPI for offline use
play a synthesized 8-bit capture jingle via the Web Audio API
disambiguation: Not a Pokemon encyclopedia or reference tool; the Pokedex is a personal catch log driven by how much you type.
extras: No Pokemon sprites are distributed with the plugin for copyright reasons; users must download the 2050 GIFs (or rely on an online fallback from PokeAPI). The author states it is an unofficial, non-commercial fan project not affiliated with Nintendo or The Pokemon Company. Installation via BRAT is described, and a Node.js command-line script is offered as an optional way to fetch sprites.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to make long writing sessions feel rewarding or track typing progress in a playful way.
summary: Typing gamification plugin that spawns catchable Pokemon as you write, logging each capture in a full 1025-entry Pokedex with a catch log and stats.
